summary: Energy Services of America Corporation filed a Form 8-K on September 17, 2026, declaring a quarterly cash dividend of $0.04 per common share, payable October 15, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business on September 30, 2026. The board authorized the distribution with no premium, advisor, or structural conditions attached; the filing is a routine capital-return event rather than a transaction. No buyback, tender, or special dividend mechanics are disclosed. Watch for consistency of the payout versus operating cash flow and any future modification to the dividend policy.
